tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so// ༄༅// swa sti/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rjes gnang bya tshul ni/ gcig bstan pas kun shes par 'gyur te/ de la thog mar grub chen lū hi pa la/ bsham ni stegs ji ltar rigs pa la maṇḍal steng du 'bru'i tshom bu gcig bkod/ grub chen dang*/ gzhi bdag gam phyogs skyong thun mong gi zlum gtor gcig chus sbyangs/ de dag gi mdun du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rnams maṇḍal gyi mtha' la gru bzhir bsham pa sogs rjes gnang spyi dang mthun/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog dang bcas pa bsham/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs spyi 'gre/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang*/ dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rdo rje 'chang la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badzra dha ra hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas mdun gyi maṇḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la skad cig gis grub chen lū hi pa sku mdog dud ka grub thob kyi cha lugs can/

skyes pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug lū hi pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ āḥlū hi pa hūm̐/ zhes ci ltar rigs pa bzlas/ de nas gtor ma byin rlabs bsdus pa'i spyi 'gre dang*/ oṃ āḥlū hi pa sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bdag cag dpon slob thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces gtor ma'i phud phul/ lhag ma gzhi bdag la 'bul na/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a karṣā ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ bhū mi pa ti la a kā ro btags pas 'bul ba sogs spyi 'gre/ yang phyogs skyong la 'bul na/ da sha di kas spyan drangs/ oṃ ind+rā ya sogs cha gsum gtor mas phyogs skyong skabs bzhin lan gsum gyis phul/ phyogs skyong ba khyed rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i phyi nang gi bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi slob mas me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ 'dir grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i nang nas slob dpon chen po lū hi pa'i byin rlabs sam rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la slob dpon gyis bya bar 'os pa rnams da lan nas grub par bgyis te/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ bla ma dang rdo rje 'chang chen po tha mi dad pa la rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/

de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// lan gsum/ des thun mong pa'i gsol ba btab nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la rnal 'byor dbang phyug lū hi pa'i byin rlabs dang rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje 'chang la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs spyi 'gre tshar gsum/ rgyud dag par byas nas/ rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi tha mal par snang ba'i 'dug gnas/ rnam smin sha rus kyis bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis slob dpon lū hi pa sku mdog dud ka grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ skyes pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po re re gsal lam ste byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas slob dpon bskyed pa dang bcas pa la gus 'dud byas pas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas grub thob lū hi pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs te/

khyed rang rnams kyi ba spu'i bu ga nas sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ rdo rje gsor/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ oṃ āḥlū hi pa hūm̐/ ā be sha ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes yang brjod/ de ni rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa yin/ rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po dang*/ oṃ yig gi phreng ba byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim pas lus kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin brlabs zhugs/ snang stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du sems gnas tshad mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po dang*/ ā yig gi phreng ba byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsal stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du sems gnas tshad mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po dang*/ hūm̐ yig gi phreng ba byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas/ yid kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ rig stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du sems gnas tshad mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dang yig 'bru gsum gyi phreng ba byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum du thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag

dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bde stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du sems gnas tshad mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ de ltar dbang bzhi legs par thob nas grub chen lū hi pa'i rtogs brjod kyi sgo nas ngo sprad pa ni/ khyi rgod mi bsrun sna la sbrang rtsi bskus pas phyogs rnams kun tu bza' bar byed// blo dman skal med dag la bla ma'i gdams ngag byin pas rang rgyud bsregs// glang chen myos pa'i sna la ral gri btags pas dgra dpung 'joms// skal bzang skye med rtogs pa bdag ni snang ba thug phrad dag gis rnam rtog 'joms// zhes gsungs pas de'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rjes gnang byin rlabs zab mo gsan pa yin pas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams la srung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs gsum/ gtang rag tu maṇḍal/ deng nas brtsams te/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs spyi dang mthun/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlabs nas sngags mchod kyis 'bul ba/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang zhing bzod par gsol ba/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams spyi dang mthun// ༈ /rjes gnang btud nas byed dgos na maṇḍal gyi tshom bu gsar du bkod/ gtor ma dang mchod pa kha gsos/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ slob dpon gyi bdag bskyed gong gi de gas chog pas bskyar nas mi mdzad/ mdun bskyed dang slob ma'i skabs su slob dpon gyi mtshan dang sngags/ rtogs brjod rnams brje ba ma gtogs gzhan thams cad gong bzhin mdzad/ rtogs brjod rnams blo la zin na dang*/ ma zin na dpe thog nas mdzad pas chog sang nyin zhag gis mtshams chod na bdag bskyed gong bzhin tshar re mdzad/ dang po lū hi pa ni gong du song*//

༈ /gnyis pa grub chen dā ri ka pa sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ 'khor skyes pa/ sngags/ oṃ āḥdā ri ka pa hūm̐/ rtogs brjod ni/ bde chen rang la yod kyang ma rtogs 'khrul pas bcings// bde bsal 'dod pas bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis bya// tshogs gnyis ma bsags skye ba brgya ru 'bad byas kyang*// bla ma dag dang mi ldan bde chen rtogs mi 'gyur// ༈ /gsum pa grub chen ḍem ki pa sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥḍem ki pa hūm̐/ rta dang glang po rgya mtsho 'dra na rab tu bde// spre'u byis pa chu ris 'dra na rtogs pa yin// chu bo nyi ma sman dang 'dra na dbyer mi phyed// gtsug phud mig dang 'khor lo lta bu'i 'bras bu thob// ༈ /bzhi pa grub chen lī la pa sku mdog rgyan 'khor ḍem ki pa dang 'dra/ oṃ āḥlī la pa hūm̐/ tshad med bzhi yi dgon pa ru// rnal 'byor rgyal po seng ge bzhin// mgo la g.yu mdog ral lngas brgyan// rnal 'byor dbang rtags rigs lnga 'chang*// seng ge'i sder mo bcu dag gis// glang chen la sogs sha rus 'byed// rnal 'byor pha rol phyin bcu yis// de dag mi mthun phyogs las 'byed// lī la pa yis rtogs nas grol// ༈ /lnga pa grub chen birwa pa sku mdog smug nag g.yas gdan la brten cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ me tog sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan dang do shal pus 'khyud dang bcas rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥbi rū pa hūm̐/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes pa ste// mi bsam mi spyad 'bad med ngang la bzhag /chad par mi 'gyur nyams myong rang gis rig /rtag par mi 'gyur zhen med zung du 'jug/ ༈ /drug pa ḍombhi pa sku mdog dkar po dar sham can stag gi steng na gnas pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥḍombhi pa hūm̐/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi nus pa yis// lcags sogs gser du bsgyur ba ltar// rin chen dbang gi nus pa yis// nyon mongs gnyis med ye shes 'gyur//

༈ /bdun pa grub chen sha wa ri pa sku mdog dud ka grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥsha wa ri pa hūm̐/ ma rig pa yi nags tshal du// gzung 'dzin ri dwags rgyu ba la// thabs dang shes rab gzhu bdungs nas// snying po'i don gyi mda' 'phangs pas// shi ni rnam par rtog pa shi /sha ni gnyis su med par zos// ro ni bde ba chen por myong*// 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po thob// ༈ /brgyad pa grub chen sa ra ha sku mdog ser po bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya can/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥs ra ha hūm̐/ kye ho grogs dag lhan cig skyes pa de// gzhan nas mi rnyed bla ma'i zhal nas rnyed// don dam zhal gyi ngo bo de rtogs nas// yid la 'chi med rlung la chad pa med// ༈ /dgu pa grub chen kaṃ ka ri pa sku mdog rdza gsar pa'i mdog can grub thob kyi cha lugs 'gyings pas gnas pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥkaṃ ka ri pa hūm̐/ ji ltar nam mkha' stong pa la// gcig dang gzhan gnyis spangs pa'i gzugs// rang snang ye shes btsun mo ni// dpe med tha snyad kun las 'das// ༈ /bcu pa grub chen mī na pa sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol ba/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥmī na pa hūm̐/ lcags kyu thogs pa'i nya pa ni// las dbang rgya mtsho'i nang du khyer// nya chen lus la rten bcas nas// lha chen gdams pa nyams blangs pas// yon tan sa dang rdo dag gis// ma theg mī na pa ru grags// ༈ /bcu gcig pa grub chen go rakṣa pa'am yan lag med pa'i rdo rje sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs can phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs shing mtshan ma bsgrengs pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥgo rakṣa pa hūm̐/ rigs ni 'bring dang mchog dang tha ma ru// gnas pa'i rgyu la rkyen gyi stobs ldan pas// gegs med las dbang 'bras bu ngo mtshar che// tso'u rāṅga yis byang sems bsnyen bkur byas// de rkyen khams kyi stobs kyis sa bon btab// a tsintaṃ yis 'chi med bdud rtsi bsten// go rakṣa pa gnyis med de nyid mthong*// srid gsum ba rdzi'i rgyal po ngo mtshar che//

༈ /bcu gnyis pa grub chen tso'u rāṅga sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥtso'u rāṅga hūm̐/ thog med srid par yun ring du// ma rig sdong po'i rtsa ba la// sred pa'i chu bos legs brlan nas// srid pa'i yan lag sna tshogs rgyas// ma rig pa yi shing chen de// bla ma dam pa'i byed pa dang*// shes rab gsum gyi rte'u yis// tso'u rāṅga yis de ring bcad// ༈ /bcu gsum pa grub chen bī ṇa pa sku mdog sngon po grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥbi ṇā pa hūm̐/ phyin ci log la goms pa'i sgra// gus dang brtson pas bcad bya gsungs// ma grol skye med sgra bshad pas// bī ṇa pa yis bdag med rtogs// ༈ /bcu bzhi pa grub chen ratna ā ka ra shānti pa sku mdog ser po dge slong gi cha lugs can/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥshānti pa hūm̐/ bu chung ma yis gsos pas gyad kyi stobs dang ldan pa ji bzhin du// blo chung dag ni bla ma'i gdams ngag rim gyis khrid pas theg pa che// rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad rnams sman gyi nus pas sel ba ltar// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nad rnams bla ma'i gdams pas skad cig bsregs// ༈ /bco lnga pa grub chen tog tse pa sku mdog ljang gu grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥtog tse pa hūm̐/ bde sdug thams cad sems las byung*// gdams pas sems kyi ri bo brkos// sa yi ri bo brkos gyur kyang*// gnyug ma'i bde chen thob mi 'gyur// tha mal shes pa snying gi dkyil du sad// tshogs drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi chad// brtags pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// bsgom du med do gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog/ ༈ /bcu drug pa grub chen tant+ri pa sku mdog dkar po/ dar sham can/ zhabs gnyis 'khril ba/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥtant+ri pa hūm̐/ 'jig rten pa yi thags mkhan dag ni snal ma thags su 'thag

/nga ni bla ma'i gdams pa chos rnams thags su 'thag /stong nyid gnas su ye shes snal ma gdams ngag stag so dang*// shes rab kyi ni sgrom bus dbyings rig gnyis med chos skur btags// ༈ /bcu bdun pa grub chen tsam ri pa ko lpags mkhan sku mdog sngon po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ lag na gri bzung ba/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥtsa ma ri pa hūm̐/ rnam rtog mtshan ma'i ko ba ni// stong nyid snying rje'i sbang dag tu// 'jig rten chos brgyad skud pa dang*// shes rab nyams myong snyung bus 'tshems// lhun grub chos sku'i lh+wam byed pa// tsa ma ri pa lh+wam mkhan mchog/ ༈ /bco brgyad pa grub chen khaḍga pa sku mdog dkar po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥkhaḍga pa hūm̐/ mtshon cha med pa'i dpa' bo ni// rgyun du dgra dang g.yul 'gyed pa// bdag nyid dgra yi dbang du 'gro// 'chi med ye shes ral gri yis// srid gsum dgra rnams pham byas nas// khaḍga pa ni longs spyod byed// ༈ /bcu dgu pa grub chen nā gārdzu na 'phags pa klu sgrub sku mdog gur gum gyi mdog can dge slong gi cha lugs/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥnā gārdzu na hūm̐/ gang zhig ma rtogs pa yis rtogs pa'i spyod pa mi bya ste// byas na rgyal po'i khrims la 'bangs kyis gnon pa bzhin// rtogs pa rnams kyis ma rtog pa yi spyod pa mi bya ste// byas na glang chen rab tu myos pa 'dam du zin pa 'dra// ༈ /nyi shu pa grub chen nag po pa sku mdog dmar ser grub thob kyi cha lugs kyis bzhengs pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥnag po pa hūm̐/ shing rta 'khor lo bzhi dang mi ldan khrid kyang 'gro bar mi nus ltar// sbyin sogs 'bad pa byas kyang bla ma gcig dang mi ldan dngos grub dam ma yin// bya rgod rtsal rdzogs gdab gshog rgyas pa dag ni nam mkhar bskyod cing rgyu// skal bzang rnal 'byor dam pa rnams ni dbang gi gdams pa khong du chud pas bde//

༈ /nyer gcig pa grub chen ārya de wa sku mdog ser po dge slong gi cha lugs can bzhengs pa/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥ.ārya de wa hūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo gcig /de yi rang bzhin rang gi sems// rtogs na 'dod pa ji bzhin zhog /goms par byas na mngon du 'gyur// ༈ /nyer gnyis pa grub chen tha ga na sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥtha ga na pa hūm̐/ gang zhig rna bar chu zhugs pa// chu nyid kyis ni 'byin pa bzhin// de bzhin snang srid brdzun pa la// brdzun pa bsgoms pas bden pa mthong*// ༈ /nyer gsum pa grub chen te lo pa sku mdog nag po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥte lo pa hūm̐/ sngags kyi sdom pa'i mchog nyid ni// rang gis rtogs las gzhan med de// gnyug ma'i sems kyi rtogs pa gang*// sangs rgyas thams cad des mthong yin// ༈ /nyer bzhi pa grub chen nā ro pa sku mdog ljang sngon grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥnā ro pa hūm̐/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal dpung gi tshogs// gling rnams kun la dbang byed ltar// lhan cig skyes pa'i ro rnyed nas// 'khor ba dbang bsgyur bde ba che// ༈ /nyer lnga pa grub chen shyā li pa sku mdog mi sha kha dkar ba gzhon nu'i gzugs 'dzin grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥshyā li pa hūm̐/ ri rab gser gyi ngos la bya gnas pa// bya yi rang bzhin bor nas gser du snang*// mkhas pa gang zhig skye ba med rtogs pa// dngos po'i rang bzhin bor nas bde ba che// ༈ /nyer drug pa grub chen tsa ta pa sku mdog dmar po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥtsa ta pa hūm̐/ rnal 'byor pa yis gang mthong gdams pa de// mthong ba skye med rtogs phyir slob dpon mchog /byis pa gnyis med rtogs phyir de thabs yin// dge sdig 'bras bu de las gnyis mi 'byung*//

༈ /nyer bdun pa grub chen bha dra pa sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs kyis bzhengs pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥbha dra pa hūm̐/ stong nyid rtogs pas 'khrul pa dag /byams pa bsgoms pas spyod pa rdzogs// sna tshogs gnyis med bsgom pa yin// spyi mthun ro gcig 'bras bu che// ༈ /nyer brgyad pa grub chen dho khan dhi pa sku mdog nag po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥdho khan dhi pa hūm̐/ kun rdzob bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*// don dam rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis// zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po bsgom// 'bras bu sku lnga ye shes lnga// ༈ /nyer dgu pa grub chen a dzo ki sku mdog mi sha kha grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ phyag na slong ba'i snod bsnams pa/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥ.a dzo ki hūm̐/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis// steng sgo sna rtser thig le bsgom// de nyid la ni blo brtan pas// yungs kar stong gsum dmigs pa stor// ༈ /sum cu pa grub chen ka la pa sku mdog gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can grub thob kyi cha lugs can thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥka la pa hūm̐/ 'gro ba 'di dag thog med dus nas 'khrul// 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin 'jig rten smyon par grags// bla ma'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi sman gyis ni// 'khrul pa'i nad rnams skad cig gcig la bsregs// ༈ /so gcig pa grub chen dho pi pa sku mdog dmar ser grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥdho pi pa hūm̐/ yun ring dus su dri ma 'khrud byas kyang*// sol ba'i rang bzhin dkar po 'gyur mi srid// rnam dag rang bzhin stong nyid kyis dag la// bla ma'i gdams ngag rang bzhin khrus mkhan mchog/ ༈ /so gnyis pa grub chen me ko pa 'od mdzad sku mdog rdza gsar pa'i mdog can grub thob kyi cha lugs/ g.yas ral gri bsnams pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥme ko pa hūm̐/

bla ma dag las dang po rang gi sems rtogs bya// de nas rnam pa kun tu tha dad mi bya ste// gnyis med goms pas dur khrod gnas su 'dug par bya// mnyam par rtogs nas smyon pa'i brtul zhugs dag gis spyod// ༈ /so gsum pa grub chen kampa ri pa sku mdog dkar po gzhon nu'i gzugs mdzes grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥkampa ri pa hūm̐/ lus po stong nyid sol mal du// dran rig rnam rtog sol ba la// la lā ra sā'i sbud pa yis// dhū trīr ye shes me sbar bas// dug gsum rnam rtog chos skur brdungs// kampa ri pas rtogs nas grol// ༈ /so bzhi pa grub chen dza landha ra sku mdog kham pa zhabs gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥdza landha ra pa hūm̐/ khams gsum lus ngag yid gsum gyi// dran rig rnam pa sna tshogs kun// la la ra sā dhū tī ru// bdag gis ci phyir 'ching bar bgyi// ༈ /so lnga pa grub chen rā hu la sku mdog nag po phyag gnyis spyi bor pheṃ pheṃ sgra'i phyag rgya mdzad pa grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥrā hu la hūm̐/ phyi yi sgra gcan bzang po yis// snang ba zla ba gnyis med zos// kun rdzob thig le zla ba ni// dbyings rig sgra gcan gnyis med zos// ༈ /so drug pa grub chen dharma pa sku mdog nag po phyag na rnga bzung ba grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥdharma pa hūm̐/ snang srid chos kyi kong bu ru// byang chub sems kyi mar khu la// tshogs drug rnam shes sdong bu btsugs// gnyis med ye shes me spar nas// rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i bud shing bsregs// ༈ /so bdun pa grub chen dho ka ri pa sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥdho ka ri pa hūm̐/ chos dbyings rang bzhin snod dag tu// rig pa chos sku'i rdzas dag bcug /dbyings rig gnyis med 'bras bu ni// las can rnal 'byor rig pas rtogs//

༈ /so brgyad pa grub chen me dhi ni sku mdog sngo ljang grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ ā me dhi ni hūm̐/ rig pa gnyug ma'i shes rab dang*// nyams myong gsang ba'i thabs dag gis// rang bzhin gnas lugs gzhi dag la// bde chen lhun grub 'bras bu rtogs// ༈ /so dgu pa grub chen paṅka dza pa sku mdog gur gum mdog can phyag na thod pa bsnams pa/ grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥpaṅka dza pa hūm̐/ ji ltar bla mas ma zin ma rtogs dus dag tu// yid bzhin nor bu dag dang nor bu mching bu mnyam// don gyi rtogs pa'i bla mas yongs su zin gyur na// nyi zla'i 'od dang srin bu me khyer ji bzhin no// ༈ /bzhi bcu pa grub chen dril bu pa sku mdog dmar ser/ rtags langs pa/ rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa/ rus pa'i rgyan can 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥrdo rje dril bu ba hūm̐/ la lā ra sā dhū tī gsum// bdag byin brlabs pas bcing bar bya// bla ma sems dang snang ba gsum// rtogs pa bskyed phyir mkhas pas bsten// ༈ /zhe gcig pa grub chen dzo ki pa sku mdog mi sha kha grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥdzo ki pa hūm̐/ mar me'i rtse mo lta bu yi// phra zhing phyed pa'i yid bsgoms pas// brtan cing g.yo ba'i dngos po kun// chos kyi dbyings su rnam par grol// ༈ /zhe gnyis pa grub chen tsa lo ki sku mdog nag po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥtsa lo ki hūm̐/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag ni// yun ring dus su bsgoms pa yis// sa sogs rim pas thim pa las// rang snang phyag rgya chen por 'gyur// ༈ /zhe gsum pa grub chen ghu dhu ri pa sku mdog sngo ljang dge bsnyen gyi cha lugs po ti bsnams pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥghu dhū ri pa hūm̐/ phyi nang chos kun sems su 'dus// sems nyid gsal bar rtogs pa na// spyod lam rnam bzhi chos kyi sku// rtogs pa mngon gyur rdzogs sangs rgyas//

༈ /zhe bzhi pa grub chen lu tsi ka sku mdog dkar po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥlu tsi ka hūm̐/ gang zhig thog ma med dus nas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor yun ring 'khyams// bla ma dam pa'i gru dag gis// brgal dka'i mtsho las de ring brgal// ༈ /zhe lnga pa grub chen kaṃ ka na sku mdog rdza gsar pa'i mdog can phyag na zla ba bsnams pa grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥkaṃ ka na hūm̐/ rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu la// nyams su myong ba'i mdog byung bas// spyod pa nus pas dgos 'dod 'byung*// ro snyoms ldan pa rnams kyis 'grub// ༈ /zhe drug pa grub chen kaṃ pa li sku mdog ser po rus pa'i rgyan can zhabs gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥkaṃ pa li hūm̐/ rgya mtsho zab cing rgya che'i nang na nor bus gang ba la// klu yi rgyal po rnams ni de la longs spyod ngo mtshar che// de bzhin snang grags thams cad ye nas chos sku yin pa la// rtogs dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams kyis longs spyod ngo mtshar che// ༈ /zhe bdun pa grub chen bhande pa sku mdog sngo skya grub thob kyi cha lugs can phyag gnyis chos 'chad/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥbhande pa hūm̐/ gnas lugs rtogs pa snying rje yin// zag med bde ba dga' ba ste// mngon zhen med pa byams pa'i mchog /gzhi mthun ro gcig btang snyoms rdzogs// ༈ /zhe brgyad pa grub chen tante pa sku mdog gur gum mdog can ras gos gsol zhing mdza' bo khyi khrid pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥtante pa hūm̐/ ji ltar dran rig sna tshogs dag /rtog med dbyings su zad cing 'gags// de bzhin snang srid chos rnams kun// stong nyid dbyings su zad cing 'gags// ༈ /zhe dgu pa grub chen ku ku ri pa sku mdog mi sha kha dmar ba grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ khyi mos dku g.yon nas 'khyud pa/ 'khor bud med/

oṃ āḥku ku ri pa hūm̐/ sangs rgyas mchod sogs rnams la don mi 'byung*// 'dod dang 'bad rtsol yod na sangs rgyas min// byin rlabs bla ma'i zhal las nyams myong 'phel// bla ma'i cha yis yod kyang don las min// ༈ /lnga bcu pa grub chen kuñdza li sku mdog gur gum mdog can thod pa bsnams pa grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥkuñdza li pa hūm̐/ gang gang lhan cig skyes pa ni// glang po che yi mig bzhin du// gze re skyes na zung rngu 'gyur// lhod na zhen med bsam gtan mchog /bla ma'i gsung gi 'od zer gyis// yod dang med pa'i mtha' ma rnyed// gang zhig ma rnyed pa de mtha'// mtha' de rtogs na don gyi mchog/ ༈ /nga gcig pa grub chen dha ma pa sku mdog nag po grub thob kyi cha lugs can phyag na dar gyi cod pan bsnams pa/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥdha ma pa hūm̐/ gnyis 'dzin ma rig dug dag gis// rig pa'i skyes bu rgyun du zin// bla ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs kyis// snang srid 'khrul pa'i dug nad bsang*// ༈ /nga gnyis pa grub chen ma ti la sku mdog ser po dbyug pa ser po bsnams pa/ grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥm hi la hūm̐/ ma rig nga rgyal ri bo yis// rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu sgrib// spyod par nus pas dgos 'dod 'byung*// ro snyoms ldan pa rnams kyis 'grub// ༈ /nga gsum pa grub chen a tsinta sku mdog ljang sngon/ grub thob kyi cha lugs can thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥ.a tsinta hūm̐/ dmigs med phyag rgya chen po ru// 'khrul pa'i dran rig sna tshogs stor// ye shes rig pa'i snang ba yis// rang snang phyag rgya chen por mthong*// ༈ /nga bzhi pa grub chen bha wa ha sku mdog gur gum gyi mdog can/ grub thob kyi cha lugs can mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥbha wa ha hūm̐/ bde'o bde'o dngos med bde// zhen med pa yi dngos med bde// brtags pa thams cad ngo shes bde// bsgrub bya med pa'i sangs rgyas bde//

༈ /nga lnga pa grub chen laṃ pa sku mdog dkar po dar sham can/ grub thob kyi cha lugs kyis zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥn li pa hūm̐/ spyi bor padma 'dam skyes su// sa bon g.yo ba dga' ba ste// snying ga mgrin pa mchog tu dga'// bral dga' bla na med pa'o// ༈ /nga drug pa grub chen bhu su ku zhi ba lha sku mdog ser po dge slong gi cha lugs/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥbhu su ku hūm̐/ bdag gis ma rtogs pa yi dus su 'bras chan ro yi khyad par che// rtogs nas mngar ba'i 'bras chan dag dang ro 'di khyad par med// de bzhin ma rtogs bar du 'khor ba dag dang sangs rgyas khyad par che// rtogs pa'i dus su 'khor ba ye nas sangs rgyas bde ba che// ༈ /nga bdun pa grub chen ind+ra bo dhi sku mdog ljang sngon rgyal po'i cha lugs kyis 'gying zhing bzhugs pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥ.ind+ra bo dhi hūm̐/ dus kyi sna rtse'i bdag byin rlabs dang mi ldan na// phyi dang nang du spyod pa dag gis sangs mi rgya// bde bas sangs rgyas dag dang khyad par med gyur na// zhen pa rab tu btang nas nyams myong mchog tu gyur// ༈ /nga brgyad pa lcam legs smin ka ra sku mdog sngo ljang mi ro steng na zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas bzhugs pa rus pa'i rgyan can/ phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥlegs smin ka ra hūm̐/ dang po blo ldan rtogs pa bskyed// gnyis pa nang du ma yengs bsgom// nyams su myong bar gyur pa na// spyod pa dag ni spyad par bya// ༈ /nga dgu pa grub chen dzā lend+ra pa sku mdog dkar po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥdzā lend+ra pa hūm̐/ ye shes rig pa'i rang bzhin ni// thad ka ma de gnyug mar gnas// ji ltar rtogs bsam nges pa yin// rnam rtog dran pa de nyid min//

༈ /drug cu pa grub chen nir gu ṇa sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis pa thal mo sbyar ba grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥnir gu ṇa hūm̐/ chu rlabs lta bu'i nyams brtan nas// spyod pa bag gis dro ba bya// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis// chags sdang rtog pa rang zhi bya// ༈ /re gcig pa grub chen pa tsa ri pa sku mdog dmar ser ras gos bsnams shing*/ mdza' bor khyi khrid pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥpa tsa ri pa hūm̐/ gang yang ma lta dbus su ltos// mchog dang dga' bral bde ba che// sngags kyi gsang ba stobs spyad nas// rnal 'byor rtags ni bsdu bar bya// ༈ /re gnyis pa grub chen tsam pa ka sku mdog gur gum gyi mdog can grub thob kyi cha lugs kyis bzhengs pa/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥtsam pa ka hūm̐/ thabs dang shes rab a dza na lta bu// bla ma chu bo'i rgyun gyis kun la khyab// lhan cig skyes pa'i dpag bsam shing dag la// 'bras bu sku gsum rang gsal rang la rdzogs// ༈ /re gsum pa grub chen bhikṣa ṇa sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥbhikṣa ṇa hūm̐/ bla med bgrod dka'i byang chub gnas chen du// zung 'jug bde chen byang chub lam bstan nas// 'bras bu phyogs cha bral ba'i byang chub mchog /bla ma dam pa'i drin gyis de nyid rtogs// ༈ /re bzhi pa grub chen til rdung pa sku btsod kyi mdog can grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥtil rdung pa hūm̐/ sems kyi byed las bde sdug 'byung*// kun rdzob til snum tshong zog gis// 'di phyi'i don rnams 'grub mi 'gyur// rang sems bla ma'i gdams ngag gis// don dam ye shes snum btsongs pas// gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po rtogs// ༈ /re lnga pa grub chen ku mā ri pa sku mdog mi sha kha dkar ba gzhon nu'i gzugs can grub thob kyi cha lugs 'dzin pa/ 'khor bud med/

oṃ āḥku mā ri pa hūm̐/ rgyu mthun mtshan ma'i 'khor lo yis// srid pa'i zlos gar sna tshogs byas// ye shes rig pa'i me yis ni// ma rig 'khrul pa'i bud shing bsregs// ༈ /re drug pa grub chen dhu me pa sku mdog btsod kha phyag g.yas na zla ba bsnams pa grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥdhu me pa hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa mchog /rang gis rtogs las gzhan du med// gnyug ma'i sems nyid rtogs pa gang*// sangs rgyas thams cad des mthong yin// ༈ /re bdun pa rnal 'byor ma ma ṇi bha drwa sku mdog mi sha kha zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhugs shing phyag na thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥm ṇi bha drā hūm̐/ gang zhig ma rtogs dus kyi tshe// rnam rtog sna tshogs sgra phyir 'brangs// de nyid rang bzhin mngon gyur tshe// rang snang rang bzhin de nyid mthong*// ༈ /re brgyad pa rnal 'byor ma me kha lā sku mdog dmar ser rdo rje dang dril bu bsten pa rnal 'byor ma'i cha lugs can/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥme kha la hūm̐/ phyi dang nang kun sems su 'dus// zhen pa med na ro snyoms ldan// 'bad rtsol med na sgom pa'i mchog /gnyis med bde chen rdzogs sangs rgyas// ༈ /re dgu pa rnal 'byor ma ka na kha lā sku mdog dmar mo me'i mdog can/ phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥka na kha la hūm̐/ go cha chen po gon nas kyang*// nor bu lta bu'i snying stobs kyis// rang rig sems kyi gru btang nas// mi ro'i khog par nges par zhugs// ༈ /bdun cu pa grub chen ki li ki li sku mdog dkar ser smad sham dang bcas pa'i grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥki li ki li hūm̐/ chos dbyings rnam dag mkha' dbyings su// skye med 'brug sgra legs sgrogs pas// snang srid 'khrul pa'i chos rnams kun// sku gsum 'bras bu'i kha dog mdzes//

༈ /don gcig pa grub chen kan tha li pa tshem bu sku mdog gur gum mdog can grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥkan tha li pa hūm̐/ bla ma'i gdams pa'i khab dag dang*// rang gi snying rje'i skud pa yis// khams gsum ma lus gos su btsem// gos kyi rnal 'byor ngo mtshar che// ༈ /don gnyis pa grub chen dha gu ri pa sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs bzhengs la/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥdha gu ri pa hūm̐/ ji ltar rnam rtog rjes 'brang 'khrul// ma 'brel bag chags ma btang bzung*// gang la mi gnas 'phro ba bsdu// gzhan las btsal bas de rnyed min// ༈ /don gsum pa grub chen u dhi ri pa sgeg pa'i rdo rje sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥ.u dhi ri pa hūm̐/ rtogs brjod ni/ ji ltar rnam rtog sogs gong dang 'dra// ༈ /don bzhi pa grub chen ka pā li pa sku mdog nag po grub thob kyi cha lugs can bzhengs pa phyag na bum pa bsnams pa/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥka pā li pa hūm̐/ dngos kun gnyis med rdo rje 'dzin// rgyan sogs thor ba glo bur ba// ngar 'dzin 'khrul pa de nyid de// rang gis btsal bas rnyed ma yin// ༈ /don lnga pa grub chen ki ra la pa sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs can gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥki ra la pa hūm̐/ ji srid ma rtogs bar du rang gzhan rtogs pas bcing*// de tshe rtogs par gyur na rang gzhan gnyis ma grub// des na sangs rgyas zhes bya rang gi blos btags yin// de nyid spros bral ma bcos ma bslang rang sems zung*// ༈ /don drug pa grub chen mtsho skyes rdo rje sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥmatsho skyes rdo rje hūm̐/

klu rgyal ba su ka gzir nas// 'gro ba sdug bsngal gdungs pa la// 'dod yon dag gi char phab bo// de bzhin nyid kyi gnas chen du// rig pa'i klu rgyal nyid gzir nas// skal ldan rig 'dzin pho mo la// gsang sngags rig pa'i char phab bo// ༈ /don bdun pa grub chen sarba bhakṣa la sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥsarba bhakṣa la hūm̐/ bdag gis ma rtogs dus na sna tshogs ro la khyad par che// gang zhig rtogs pa'i dus su ro rnams ngo bo bye brag med// de bzhin ma rtogs dus su 'khor ba sangs rgyas tha dad snang*// de nyid rtogs pa'i dus su 'khor ba sangs rgyas bde ba che// ༈ /don brgyad pa grub chen nā ga bo dhi klu'i byang chub sku mdog sngo ljang dge slong gi cha lugs can tsog pur 'dug pa phyag na po ti bsnams pa/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥnā ga bo dhi hūm̐/ sa la gnas pa kun kyang skal ba bzang*// dbul ba rgya mtshor phyin na dbul dang bral// ral gri lag tu thogs na longs spyod che// phyogs med sa la phyin na gnyen dang phrad// ༈ /don dgu pa grub chen pu ta li sku mdog dmar ser grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥpu ta li hūm̐/ thams cad bde gshegs rang bzhin te// blo zhan log pa'i lam spangs nas// snying po'i 'bras bu gdon mi za// bla mar dbang blang lhan skyes kyi// ro yis kun la khyab byas te// skye med rgyas 'debs rdo rje 'dzin// ༈ /brgyad cu pa grub chen pa na ha sku mdog ser po grub thob kyi cha lugs can phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ 'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥpa na ha hūm̐/ snying po gnyug ma'i don bsams pas// ji ltar rtogs sems nges pa yi// des na de nyid rang dga' yin// dngos grub thob pa thal byung ngo*// ༈ /gya gcig pa grub chen ko ki li pa sku mdog ser po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa grub thob kyi cha lugs/

'khor skyes pa/ oṃ āḥko ki li pa hūm̐/ bya ba btang na man ngag yin// zhen 'dod med na rtogs pa yin// bde ba dngos med sgom pa yin// bsgrub bya med na spyod pa'i mchog/ ༈ /gya gnyis pa grub chen a naṃ ga sku mdog li khri'i mdog can grub thob kyi cha lugs/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥnaṃ ga hūm̐/ 'khor ba snying po med pa yi// 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus 'di la// ma rig mngon zhen drag po yi// dug gis zin pa bde bar bzung*// mngon zhen dug nad dwangs pa na// 'khor ba nyid kyang chos kyi sku// ༈ /gya gsum pa grub chen sa mu dra sku mdog dkar po grub thob kyi cha lugs can zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pas bzhengs pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥs mu dra hūm̐/ skye med rtogs kyang nyams su myong bral na// de yang srin mo'i lag tu bu khyer 'dra// nyams su myong yang gnas lugs ma shes na// de yang glang chen 'dam du zhugs pa 'dra// ༈ /gya bzhi pa grub chen byā ri pa sku mdog dkar po grub thob kyi cha lugs can/ phyag g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ 'khor bud med/ oṃ āḥbyā ri pa hūm̐/ bla ma dam pa bsten na de nyid mthong*// nam mkha'i dbyings su bsgom pa dben pa'i mchog /chos rnams yongs su rtogs na mi mthun med// nam mkha'i 'o ma de 'thung na// 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin phyir te// 'gro ba rnams kyi spang bya yin// gnod byed bdud rtsi'i sman chen 'di// thabs chen ldan pa'i rma bya yis// mthong na yid 'ong gar byed bzhin// snang srid 'khrul pa'i log lam 'di// rigs ldan rnams kyi spang bya la// bla ma nor ldan thabs chen gyis// zin na yid 'ong gar byed 'gyur// zhes pa mngon rtogs sngags dang bcas pa 'di rnams rjes gnang rim pa bzhin gnang ba'i ched du bris pa yin lags/ spros pa la dgyes pa rnams rjes gnang gi mgo ru/ slob ma rnams la sems bskyed gsal btab nas/

rnam thar rnams ngag nas brjod pa'am/ lung bklags nas rjes gnang gi ngo bo mdzad kyang rgyas pa'i yan lag tu mchi'o// 'di lta bu'i rjes gnang bya tshul ni/ rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje'i yig cha'ang mi gsal zhing phyag len mi mdzad pa rnams bsal zhing dor nas bkod pa 'di ni/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang*/ de'i thugs sras dam pa sems dpa' chen po spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi sku'i skye ba la gdon mi za ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs shing bka' drin gyis legs par bskyangs pa/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis spyan snga rin po che dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa dgu bzhes pa'i tshe 'di'i rjes gnang dang*/ so so'i lo rgyus rnam thar/ byin rlabs rjes gnang bya tshul/ rtogs brjod/ de'i 'grel pa/ tshogs 'khor/ man ngag rin po che'i phreng ba rtsa 'grel/ sku bri thabs/ bstod pa/ yang grub chen brgyad kyi bstod pa chos 'di'i byung tshul rnams thos pa'i tshe/ rjes gnang bya tshul gyi yig cha gsal bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal pa gus pa chen pos spyi bor blangs te rang dang skal ba mnyam pa rnams dang*/ ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po spun la bsams nas/ lo dgon pa'i yang dben bla ma dam pa bzhugs sa dang nye ba'i dga' ldan rtse'i klu sdings su bris nas spyan lam phab pas shin tu legs brjod dang bcas gnang ba yin pas yid ches dang byin rlabs gnyis ka yod do// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ mkha' 'gro ma ko ka li/ rma we waṃ gnyis/ de gnyis la sūrya rasmi/ bram ze'i paṇḍi ta ka ma la/

grub thob tsa ma ri pa/ paṇḍi ta mi 'jigs sbyin pa/ rtsa mi lo tsā ba/ rin po che yab sras/ ratna gu ru/ grub thob hūm̐ 'bar/ mkhan chen rgan lhas pa/ stag ston gzhon nu dang*/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ mkhan chen gzhon nu mgon/ mkhan chen grags tshul pa/ rgyal ba yon tan 'od/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ye shes rdo rje/ smyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho// mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag la'o// dharme u da ya mastu/

chos 'di dar bar gyur cig mchan/ 'di'i yi ge pa rnam dpyod dang ldan pa ngag dbang dpal 'byor ga chen gyis bgyis so// slar yang lag len bde ba'i phyir rtogs brjod rnams dkyus su bcug go /maṅgalaṃ// // ༈ /bla ma rdo rje 'chang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul grub pa mchog gi zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo badzra dhā rā ya/ shin tu rnam par dag pa yi// bde stong mchog gi rdo rje 'dzin// grub pa'i dbang phyug rgya mtsho la// phyag byas de yi byin rlabs bshad// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stegs kyi khar/ maṇḍal zlum po'i ngos su lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod pa'i mthar mchod pas bskor/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod/ bum pa bcud ldan/ nye logs su tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i longs spyod ci 'byor sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad ma tshang ba med par bsham/ gnyis pa ni/ byin rlabs kyi sgrub pa gzhan med/ rang nyid kyis rgyun du bsnyen pa'i bde kye sogs yi dam gang rigs kyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas de la brten pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya/ skabs de'i tshogs mgron la grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi byon par bsams nas tshom bu la bstims shing tshogs gtor gyis mchod/ de nas slob ma rnal 'byor bla med kyi dbang bzhis smin pa ci rigs pa bos te khrus byas/ chos bshad ji ltar 'tshams pa'i rjes su/ de la rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du chos kyi rgyal po kañdzi kas dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du mkha' 'gro ma ko ki la dang*/ dharma de bī mched gnyis ngo chen du sbran nas grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi spyan drangs te tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod pa byas pa na/ thog mar rnal 'byor dbang phyug lū hi pa byon/ de nas rim par byon te/

mthar byā li pa'i bar du byon/ rgyal pos grub thob so so'i sku re bzhengs/ lo rgyus dang rtogs brjod so sor bris/ de nas kyang rgyal rabs bzhi'i bar du tshogs 'khor la grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dngos su byon par grags/ phyis grub chen dpa' bo 'od gsal gyis lo rgyus dang rtogs brjod kyi yi ge do ha rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus/ des bram ze'i paṇḍi ta ka ma la la bshad/ des grub thob ri khrod pa dza wa ri pa la/ des ma ga dhā'i paṇḍi ta a bha ya dā na shrī la/ de las mi nyag tsa mi lo tsā ba smon grub shes rab kyis gsan te bod du bsgyur ba nas bzung bdag cag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zab mo rnams rim bzhin du 'bul ba'i skabs su babs pa las/ bdag nyid kyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams sngon du grub zin nas/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar 'jug sgo spyi'i dbang rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi byin rlabs sgrub pa'i slad du thugs dmigs 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ sa phyogs 'di nyid bla ma mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i dbus su/ seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i sna tshogs padma dang nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa rigs thams cad kyi bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum bcom ldan 'das ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud cing*/ rdo rje dang padma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i drung du gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa 'bul ba'i mos pa mdzod/

ces brjod la maṇḍal rgyas bsdus ci rigs 'bul du gzhug de nas ga shed nas ral gri sngo sangs pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi smin mtshams nas thod pa breg de'i nang du lus bcug rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pur brten pa'i 'og gi rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas zhu ba'i ma dag pa thams cad rlangs pa sngo dmar gyi rnam par phyir thon/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur pa de tshogs kyi 'khor lor 'bul ba'i mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan zhing yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /ces 'bul du gzhug de nas rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i lus las spros pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis gsang gsum gyi yon tan rjes su dran pa'i bsngags pa brjod pa'i mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gnang bar zhu/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces mchod cing phyag 'tshal bas bla ma rdo rje 'chang thugs dgyes pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa las/ thugs ka'i 'od kyis gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs par bsams la/ de rnams la gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// ces gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha dang slob dpon lhan cig pas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/

zhes brjod cing bum chu sbyin/ des bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gi ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes brjod cing nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi sbyin/ des gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam rlung dang gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas rig ma yid du 'ong ba zhig sprul te gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis// zhes pa'i rig ma dang 'du shes sum ldan gyis snyoms par zhugs pas yas babs dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// gsum pa'i dus kyi ye shes de nyid yid yul du byas te/ bde bas thabs byas pa'i stong nyid so so rang rig pa'i ye shes nyams su myong ba dbang bzhi par ngo sprad pa ni 'di la gsan pas khyab ste/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// des dbang bzhi pa thob/ bag chags kyi dri ma dag lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// mthar bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum la gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig byas pa'i rkyen gyis 'od du zhu ste khyed rang rnams la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/

ces brjod la rol mos byin dbab bo// des 'jug sgo spyi'i dbang grub nas/ grub chen so so'i byin rlabs la/ thog mar gu ru lū hi pa'i lo rgyus ni zhes mtshams sbyar la rnam thar bklag rnam thar de dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lū hi pa'i byin rlabs kyi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ ces brda sbyar/ bsdu na/ thog mar rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lū hi pa'i byin rlabs kyi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod ces sbrel/ gang ltar yang*/ mdun gyi maṇḍal 'di nyid dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal med khang bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i gzhir ri dwags kṛṣṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lū hi pa rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor nus ldan gyi rnam pa can byin rlabs kyi gzi brjid 'bar ba la/ yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i drung du maṇḍal zhig phul mdzod/ ces mchod pa dang*/ lus tshogs 'khor du 'bul ba sngar ltar la/ bstod pa'i khyad par/ gang gi drin gyis sogs kyi mthar/ lū hi pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ maṇḍal gyi nang du bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'i g.yon rkyang ma dang 'brel ba'i byang sems dkar po spyi bo'i smin mtshams nas byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ rkyang ma'i nang thams cad khengs/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang g.yas ro ma dang 'brel ba'i byang sems dmar po mgrin pa nas byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ ro ma'i nang thams cad khengs/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang dbus dbu ma dang 'brel ba'i byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa thugs ka nas byon/

khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ dbu ma'i nang thams cad gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams ni 'dra bas 'dra ba lam du byed pa mtshon byed brda'i dbang gsum yin/ da mtshon bya don gyi dbang ni/ maṇḍal na bzhugs pa'i gu ru lū hi pa'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs pa'i thugs mos gnang bar zhu/ zhes brjod la rtogs brjod tshar gcig bklag dpon slob gnyis kas cung zad re mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthar/ zhes gsungs nas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug de khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas khyed rang rnams rnal 'byor dbang phyug lū hi pa'i skur gyur/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas tshom bu'am me tog spyi bor bkod la/ spyir rgya gar grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhis byin gyis rlobs shig khyad par rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lū hi pas gdul bya slob ma 'di rnams la byin gyis brlabs kyis byin gyis rlobs shig ces dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbarjod cing rol mo bya/ des lū hi pa'i byin rlabs grub pa lags/ des rigs 'gre ste/ de nas grub chen lī la pa'i byin rlabs lā zhes mtshams sbyar la/ rnam thar dang*/ mtshan dang*/ rtogs brjod so sor sbyar/ shānti pa sogs rab byung gi rnam pa can rnams la/ mdun gyi maṇḍal 'di nyid dkon mchog gi gtsug lag khang bkod pa khyad par 'phags par/ dge sbyong gi nyer spyad gding ba'i gdan la paṇa chen shānti pa rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta sdom brtson gyi cha byad can/ dbang po zhi zhing shin tu dul ba la zhes sogs sbyar bar gsungs/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis byā li pa'i bar rim par grub rjes/ chos srung ye shes mgon po'i byin rlabs ni/ de nas mtha' rten du chos srung ye shes mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/

mdun gyi maṇḍal dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i nang du padma nyi ma bam ro bsnol ba'i gdan la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po gri gug can mngon sum du gsal ba'i spyan sngar maṇḍal zhig 'bul mdzod/ ces maṇḍal dang*/ tshogs mchod sngar ltar la/ gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal// nye bar dgongs nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba// rdo rje'i chos srung rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i g.yon rkyang ma sogs nas/ dbang gsum yin/ ces pa'i bar sngar ltar la/ de nas mtshon bya don gyi dbang gi slad du/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po de nyid khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas khyed rang rnams dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i skur gyur sogs dang*/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon pos gdul bya slob ma 'di rnams sogs brjod pa khyad par ro// de ltar na de rnams kyi sgo nas bla ma rdo rje 'chang rnal 'byor dbang phyug brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs mtha' brten dang bcas pa legs par gsan pa yin pas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ slar yang lus longs spyod 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ des byin rlabs kyi bka' zab mo legs par thob pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// de lta bu'i skabs nyin zhag gis bar chod na/ mjug tu dam tshig khas blang man bya/ nyin rjes mar bdag bskyed dang tshogs mchod sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ mgor sems bskyed gsal gdab dang bcas te grub chen so so'i rnam thar la 'jug go /gsum pa rjes ni/

tshogs la rol/ lhag ma btang*/ bdag bskyed kyi nyer bsdu sogs mjug gi bya ba rnams tshul bzhin du bya'o// grub pa'i khyu mchog che rnams kyi// byin rlabs bya tshul bklag chog tu// bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun// grub gnyis dpal la rol par shog /ces pa'ang 'jam mgon kun dga' grol mchog dang*/ chos smra ba phrin las shes rab sogs kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i dgongs pa dang bla ma'i phyag gzhes ltar/ ma hā paṇḍi ta 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros sogs las tshul 'di'i bka' drin thob pa bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge legs su gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
